commands.title: Live KiCad: Attach to running KiCad (pid)
Live KiCad: Show KiCad window in a tab (3D viewer, ...)
Live KiCad: Raise KiCad (bring the window to the front)

kiwrap.live.helperPath.description: Path of kiwrap-live.exe. Empty = <extension>/bin/kiwrap-live.exe, then helper/target/{release,debug}/kiwrap-live.exe next to the extension folder (dev). A .js/.mjs path is run with node (tests). Machine scope: user settings only.

kiwrap.live.nodePath.description: Node executable used for a .js helper (tests). Empty = the extension host itself (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE). Machine scope: user settings only.

kiwrap.live.raiseOnDoubleClick.description: Live view: a double-click on the picture raises the real KiCad window (the same as the tab's "Raise KiCad" button). A single click only focuses the tab.

enumDescriptions: the live view (default, the supported mode): the tab shows the real KiCad editor live; to edit by hand, raise KiCad
EXPERIMENTAL, unsupported: drive the visible KiCad from the tab with SendInput
EXPERIMENTAL, unsupported: drive the visible KiCad from the tab with posted input and a borrowed cursor
EXPERIMENTAL, unsupported: cloaked KiCad driven with posted messages; needs a fork build carrying mr/display-input, falls back to the live view otherwise
kiwrap.live.inputMode.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Anything but "none" injects the tab's mouse and keyboard into KiCad; these modes are unsupported research paths (docs/DECISIONS.md D20) and may leave KiCad or the pointer in an odd state. The keybinding shield is armed only while an input mode is active.

kiwrap.live.shieldKeys.description: While an EXPERIMENTAL input mode injects into a focused Live KiCad tab, swallow the VS Code keybindings a KiCad user would press (Ctrl+W, Ctrl+P, F5, ...). Has no effect in the live view (kiwrap.live.inputMode = none): VS Code's keys stay VS Code's.

kiwrap.live.keepCommandPalette.description: Keep Ctrl+Shift+P / F1 for VS Code even while the shield is on.

kiwrap.live.pointerLock.description: EXPERIMENTAL input modes: lock the pointer on click so drags never leave the tab. Esc releases it.

kiwrap.live.hud.description: Show the HUD in the tab (surface, fps / latency, the "Raise KiCad" button).

kiwrap.live.fit.description: fit = scale the KiCad frame down to the tab; native = 1 surface px per device px, the tab scrolls when the frame is larger.

kiwrap.live.fitWindowToTab.description: EXPERIMENTAL input modes only: size the captured KiCad window to the tab (physical pixels) so the stream is 1:1 and the menus, toolbars and panels stay legible. The live view never touches the desktop window.

kiwrap.live.hiddenCloseDelayMs.description: Grace period before a tab that is no longer visible closes its stream (it reconnects and resyncs when shown again).

kiwrap.live.autoOpen3d.description: Open a tab automatically when KiCad shows a 3D viewer.

kiwrap.live.retainContextWhenHidden.description: Keep Live KiCad webviews alive while hidden (faster tab switches, more memory).
